mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above 3.25% in the month preceding the forecast period reduces near-term discount rates, lowering the present value of expected equity cash flows and thereby depressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 3.25% in the prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in such regimes are not statistically lower than during pre-rate hike periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the 12-month change in CPIAUCSL exceeds +2% in a month, it signals accelerating inflation expectations that compress real equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically negative relative to the 6-month pre-inflation-signal window (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in PAYEMS of at least 5% for two consecutive months indicates strengthening labor market conditions, which raises consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by ≥5% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not statistically higher than during prior periods of weaker labor growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When GDPC1 (billions of chained USD) grows by more than 10% in a quarter relative to the prior quarter, it reflects robust consumer and business demand, which tends to boost earnings expectations and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 quarterly growth > +10% vs prior quarter
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in such quarters (Rank IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in INDPRO (monthly index) of at least 8% in a month signals supply-side weakness, lowering market confidence and compressing equity valuations, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in subsequent months do not remain persistently negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in HOUST (units) and RSAFS (dollars) above their 12-month moving averages by at least 3% each suggest coordinated strength in industrial production and retail sales, which elevates earnings expectations and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 12-month MA by ≥3% AND RSAFS > 12-month MA by ≥3%
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive when both proxies exceed their moving averages (Rank IC > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE below 3.5% for three consecutive months indicates softening labor market pressures, which often precedes a moderation in corporate investment and consumer spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not persistently negative in such regimes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains below 2% for two consecutive months in a context of rising unemployment, it signals policy accommodation that supports risk appetite, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 2% for two consecutive months AND PAYEMS < 150,000 (monthly) for the same period
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive when accommodation persists beyond the trigger window (Rank IC < 0.10).
